opening.argument: The presentation directs viewers to register for Forsage BUSD through a referral link, fund a Trust Wallet with BUSD, and proceed through authorization and transaction-approval steps. Its title identifies the subject as “HOW TO REGISTER FORSAGE BUSD,” while the instructions say to copy a referral link, fund the wallet, accept BUSD authorization, and approve a further transaction. The supplied screens reinforce that sequence, showing Forsage registration, BUSD Authorization, account creation, and a Trust Wallet confirmation screen. These are funded joining instructions tied to a referral-based platform; they do not, by themselves, show a completed payout or the full compensation matrix.
